root.name: French Defense: Diemer-Duhm Gambit Accepted
root.moves: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. c4 dxe4

overview: After 2.d4 d5 White plays 3.c4 and Black takes on e4; White follows with Nc3 and f3 to recover the pawn or build an attack. Black can keep the pawn and aim to consolidate with ...Nf6 and ...Bb4. White gets open lines and rapid development, Black the extra pawn.

white_ideas.idea: Open lines with f3 and hit e4 and e6
Regain the pawn with strong piece play

black_ideas.idea: Strike with ...c5 to break White's centre

typical_structures.structure: French centre opened up with White c4/d4 vs Black e6

character.notes: A gambit with a lead in development for White.

gambit.notes: White gives the e4 pawn and Black can keep it.

soundness.notes: Considered dubious; Black has several solid answers.

approach.notes: Rare; strong players seldom choose it.

level.reason: Not Beginner for a dubious gambit.
